summary.description: Two or three sentences: what you decided and why. Terse.

roster_assessment.description: The evaluation you do every time you wake up (D5, D7.4): where the roster is strong, thin, or misshapen; what this week's matchup asks of it; what you are watching. Written even when no action follows.

actions.description: Writes to perform, in order. Empty is a valid, common answer.

tool.description: Must be one of core's write tools. Nothing else exists.

cites.description: Playbook § and doctrine D references justifying this action, e.g. ['§4.2', 'D3.1'].

reason.description: The move and the core number behind it.

short_term.description: D8.2 — this week's starting points or risk.

long_term.description: D8.3 — ROS starting points, roster shape, bye cover, weeks 15-17.

alternative.description: D8.4 — what else was considered and why it lost.

evidence.description: D8.5 — the dossier fact, usage line or practice report, with its source.

would_be_wrong_if.description: D8.6 — the one thing that, if true, flips the call.

why_they_accept.description: propose_trade only (D9): why THIS manager says yes — their hole, their bye crunch, their record, what they paid. Required for propose_trade; also passed as the tool argument.

no_action_reason.description: Required when actions is empty. Why nothing should happen today.

uncertainties.description: §8.8 — anything you could not confirm, or where the model disagrees with itself.

escalate.description: Anything a human must decide. Leave empty if nothing. Posted to Slack for Pearce.

replies.description: §8.9 / D10 — an answer to every message in `inbox.messages`, one per ts. Each is posted as a threaded reply under the message it answers. Empty only when the inbox was empty.

ts.description: The `ts` of the message being answered, copied exactly from the packet.

answer.description: Two or three sentences in the voice of the digest: the real answer with the § behind it, or what you did about it. If it asked for a write outside §8.2, a gate that is hard in code, or the kill switch, say no and name the rule (D10.3).

acted.description: True if an action in this run exists because of this message.
